summary: Timer-driven client grid overlay controller. While the session phase (this+0x3FC4) equals 3, decrements a 7.5-second countdown timer (this+0x1C) by the frame delta dbl_8AFE98; on expiry it refreshes scene state and toggles a grid display flag (this+0x20), then resets the timer. Runs only while a unique session ID is present.

local_names.v3: cached scene/module index at expiry time
local_names.v4: scratch buffer used for the session-config description
local_names.v5: scratch buffer receiving parsed scene data

operations.description: If the session phase at this+0x3FC4 does not equal 3, return immediately; the timer logic only runs during phase 3.
Decrement the countdown timer: this+0x1C -= dbl_8AFE98 (frame delta), storing the new value back.
If the timer is still non-negative (>= 0.0), return; expiry handling only runs when it goes below zero.
Initialize the scratch description buffer via FAILWRONGDESCRIPTION(v4).
Query the unique session ID via UniqueID(v4); if it is zero the expiry body is skipped.
Cache the current scene/module index dword_8AC48C into v3 for change detection.
Parse the current scene state into the scratch buffer via SceneDataParser(v5).

If the grid display flag this+0x20 is set, run the hide sequence: SessionConfigWriteback(v4), AIW(0), SystemOSAPICall_0dc0(&unk_7CE24D), and (unless byte_7CE254 is set) sub_4A0030(&unk_7CE24C); then LookupDispatch(aMpclientgrid, -1) and clear this+0x20.
Otherwise, if the cached scene index v3 differs from the current dword_8AC48C, set the grid display flag this+0x20 to 1 (show).
Reset the countdown timer this+0x1C to 1089470464 (7.5f) after the expiry evaluation.
Release/finalize the scratch buffer via EmptyStub_0170(v4).
